entity.summary: Panama-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2018 and providing current account-based spot trading and custody services across active digital-asset markets.
entity.notes: Current first-party About material identifies Safetrade.com Inc. as a Panama-registered cryptocurrency trading platform founded in 2018. Current terms describe order matching, customer accounts, custody, deposits, withdrawals, and spot settlement. Current independent market data reports recently updated pairs and non-zero volume. The public terms also use the operator wording SafeTrade Limited Co., so confidence remains medium rather than treating the legal-entity presentation as fully resolved. January 1 is used only as a year-level launch marker.
